The '''Bubbleboost Column''' is a sub-location of the [[Moonglade Marsh]].

== Features ==
The '''Bubbleboost Column''' is a well system located in {{Zone|Tangleburg}} that leads to the {{Zone|Wyrmgrove Tomb}} and {{Zone|Kelpwoven Tunnels}}.

== Trivia ==
* Occasionally, {{Item|Spike}}s can enter the '''Bubbleboost Column''' and travel to {{Zone|Tangleburg}}.
